archive.catalogue_description: FEATURES: -A few WaW weapons -BO1 Weapons -BO2 Weapons -MW2 Weapons(THEY DO AIM NOW) -COD4 Weapons -BO1 Perks -WaW Perks -One Custom Perk -3 Main Easter Eggs -1 Mini Easter Egg -Every Packapunched Gun Has A Custom Camo(Try Them All!) -6 Wonder Weapons(including the blundergat, scavenger, the cure, thundergun, raygun mark2, and raygun) -Double Tap 2.0 -Nuketown zombie models -Drops Spawning out of map(This is on purpose, if you play the right way then you get drops ) -Buyable Ending YOUTUBE: IF ANY ONE UPLOADS THIS TO YOUTUBE PLEASE LET ME KNOW STORY: Our Four main players, show up in this hole in the ground in the middle of nowhere. They have no idea why they are here but a voice calls out to them and tells them what to do. You either listen or die, your choice but your fate may bring you gold and riches or death and despair. Is this really egypt, is this not just another trick of the mind? No matter, this map has a huge story behind it and it is waiting to be unlocked. The crazyplace was just to test your tastebuds for adventure, this map is just the begining. If you would like to make your own predictions then look for caulk writings ingame and other theory worthy items.
